description: Hand-written hypothesis input (ADR-0004): attributed before/after capture pairs from the Confessor snapshots. Two chronological sessions confirmed by file mtimes: the numbered 01-10 series (2025-12-29) and the b-series (2026-01-23..25). `order` preserves that chronology: numbered series uses the after-file number (2..10), b-series uses 100 + b-number. The pipeline (er-save-editor knowledge run) verifies each transition empirically and emits claims; nothing here is trusted without the byte-level checks passing. For family tile-pickup-row-id the `flag` field carries the ItemLotParam ROW ID (the stored id), not the getItemFlagId.
